name: Darkred
biography: is a high-school student currently residing in the United States. In his free time, he enjoys testing the vulnerabilities of companies' security and warranty policies. He does this in order to make said companies aware of serious flaws in their policies. His tests range from High Value Electronics to free coupons for soda and chips. With this information, he hopes that big companies like Apple can protect their warranty policies and their consumers.
